integrity: Analytical stationary-generator proof with exact rational finite-state replication and numerical limiting checks; neither independent review nor publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Annealed correlations on finite homogeneous cycles with fair initial opinions and independent local Poisson clocks; no assertion for arbitrary graphs, quenched individual environments or finite-sample inference. Original resetting mechanisms and classical noise scaling are prior work.
title: Fixed-opinion memory strictly enhances voter correlations on every finite ring
